title: When Shopify Is Not Easy
excerpt: For most stores Shopify is the easiest good answer in commerce. For complex B2B, the ease is borrowed from a stack of vendors you do not own.

content:
For most stores Shopify is the easiest good answer in commerce. For complex B2B, the ease is borrowed from a stack of vendors you do not own.

In this issue

  • Now Let Us Build A Hard One. Picture a complex B2B store. A distributor selling to eight hundred dealers.
  • You Become The Integrator. None of those apps know about each other, and a demo never shows you that.
  • The Vendor Question. What happens when one of those vendors goes out of business?
  • What Built In Looks Like Instead. The alternative is not magic, just a platform where B2B is part of the product instead of a layer bolted to it.
  • Znode. Znode was built for B2B from the start, and it positions its B2B feature set as built in rather than app dependent (Znode, 2025).
  • Adobe Commerce B2B. Adobe Commerce takes more work to stand up than Shopify.
  • Shopware. Shopware is the one I find most interesting on the automation question, because it answers a part of the problem the others mostly leave to humans.
